name: IT team · manager checkpoint — re-forecast M1–M3 if the pytest gate chain fails
description:
MANAGER CHECKPOINT — wake 2026-11-19T12:00Z, due 2026-11-19. This card exists so that a gate failure cannot slip the milestone dates silently.

WHY IT EXISTS
`d1ba037a` (declare the pytest suite in `qa_policy`) wakes 19 Nov 08:00 and is the single gate in front of every code merge: the QA gate currently returns `block` with `tests.no-suite`, `mapped_tests: 0`, `unmapped_sources: 27`. `5ee9dbfa` (map sources to tests) wakes 20 Nov 08:00. The three QA verdict cards wake 19 Nov 14:00 and have already been ruled to judge their own artifact, not the global gate. Nobody currently owns the management consequence if `d1ba037a` fails: M1 (21 Nov), M2 (25 Nov) and M3 (27 Nov) are all forecasts that depend on it, and `2506f948` takes the demo decision at 20 Nov 12:00.

WHAT TO DO (three steps, in order)
1. Read `d1ba037a`. Question to answer: did `qa_run_tests(suite="unit")` return a real verdict (passed, or a list of failing test ids), or is it still `tests.no-suite`?
2. GATE LIVE → post one short line on `b9aaf03c`, `299d12ce`, `140668fe`: "gate live as of <time>, dates unchanged". Stop. Do not re-plan anything else.
3. GATE STILL DEAD → do not retry the declaration yourself and do not open a new card for the same blocker. Instead:
   a. On each of `b9aaf03c`, `299d12ce`, `140668fe`, state the new forecast date as a day-for-day slip from the failure (commitment vs forecast wording: these remain forecasts, not commitments), with one line of reason.
   b. Post one escalation line on `2506f948` so the 20 Nov 12:00 demo decision is taken against the real dates — if M1 cannot be demoed on 21 Nov, the three options on that card change and management must see it before it decides.
   c. Add one line to the next shift report: which milestone moved, by how many days, and why.

ACCEPTANCE
This card ends with either "gate live, dates unchanged" recorded on the three milestone cards, or three explicit re-forecast dates plus one escalation line on `2506f948`. No new blocker cards, no repeated discovery of the same facts, no claims of progress without a date and an owner.

**Manager ruling — shift 2026-11-18 13:05 UTC. MERGED, then closed. Do not run at 19 Nov 12:00.**

This card existed to answer one question: *"if the pytest gate chain fails, what slips?"* That question is now answered, so the card has no work left:

- **The gate chain was a scope error, not a failure.** Measured this shift: this project is 45 files of shell + markdown, **0 symbols, 0 tests**, no `api/`, no `.gitignore`. A pytest suite cannot exist here. The suite everyone was waiting for lives in the parent repo `codx-junior-platform`, outside this project's readable scope.
- **The premise "gate chain fails → M1-M3 slip" is therefore void.** M1's work never depended on the gate; only its closing paperwork did, and that is now one attributed line on `b9aaf03c`.
- **The re-forecast duty does not disappear — it moves to where it belongs.** It now lives on **`70832a68` (M1 demo outcome → capture feedback and re-forecast M2/M3), wake 2026-11-21T16:00Z**, two hours after the demo. That is the correct trigger: dates are re-forecast **after** management has seen the increment, not before.
- **The live open decision is `e70e0272`** (is the app repo in scope?), wake 20 Nov 12:00Z, default A = installer repo only. If the scope answer changes the shape of M2/M3, `70832a68` applies it.

No action needed on this card. Closing it as `done` (merged), not `rejected`: the duty was real, it just belongs to another card.
